memory_annotations.evidence_summary: For this Dallas trip specifically, Marcus chose coach because business materially increased the fare without improving the schedule; this is a local exception to the business-first cabin preference.

messages.content: I need the Dallas flights settled. The leadership meeting starts Tuesday at 1:00 p.m. and ends Thursday at noon. I am leaving from Chicago, and both directions need to be nonstop.
What are the meeting dates? Also, is either Chicago airport workable, and should I compare business and coach?
November 18 through 20. Either airport is fine. Show me the sensible round trips, but for this trip coach is fine if business adds much without improving the schedule.

The strongest outbound is American from O'Hare to DFW, departing Tuesday at 7:10 a.m. and arriving at 9:43 a.m. That leaves 3 hours 17 minutes before the opening session, enough for deplaning and roughly an hour to reach central Dallas even with moderate traffic. A United option leaves at 8:05 a.m. and arrives at 10:41 a.m., leaving a tighter 2 hours 19 minutes. Southwest from Midway arrives at 10:55 a.m. Business is available on American and United; Southwest has coach only.
What do the complete round trips look like with a Thursday departure after 2:00?

American pairs the 7:10 a.m. outbound with a 3:25 p.m. DFW-ORD return arriving at 5:48 p.m.: $418 in Main Cabin or $936 in business. United pairs its 8:05 a.m. outbound with a 4:10 p.m. return arriving at 6:34 p.m.: $447 in economy or $902 in business. Southwest is $389 round trip, returning from Love Field at 3:50 p.m. and reaching Midway at 6:05 p.m. All are nonstop.
Take American in coach. The earlier arrival matters, and business is not worth the difference on this run. Is the fare changeable?

Yes. The $418 Main Cabin fare allows changes without a change fee, though any fare difference applies. It is not Basic Economy. You may cancel for a flight credit under the ticket rules. The outbound departs ORD at 7:10 a.m. Tuesday and the return departs DFW at 3:25 p.m. Thursday.
Purchase that itinerary. Do not add a hotel yet; the organizer still owes me the venue and room arrangement.

Booked for $418.00 on American, confirmation K7D3XM. Tuesday, November 18: ORD-DFW, 7:10-9:43 a.m. Thursday, November 20: DFW-ORD, 3:25-5:48 p.m. Both flights are nonstop in Main Cabin, changeable with any fare difference and cancellable for flight credit. Plan to leave the arrival gate by about 10:10 a.m.; even allowing 75 minutes to central Dallas leaves more than an hour before the 1:00 p.m. opening. No hotel was reserved. Once the venue is confirmed, lodging and Thursday airport timing remain to be settled.
